design_purpose: Prepare the next falsifiable Synthetic question at the newly reached scientific boundary without executing a new control or extending Q-ORACLE authorization.
proposed_exact_question: Can a single PRE-observable line-mean score proxy recover a material fraction of the W1 shared-state value without access to latent_skill, while preserving frozen C1 and N1 unchanged?

proposed_control.added_feature: For each rider, compute mean(score) over all riders sharing that rider's PRE line_group_id using PRE only, then add exactly 0.16 times that line mean score to the rider utility before the same PL top3 generator.
proposed_control.coefficient_rule: Fixed mechanistic transfer from the canonical W1 shared-state coefficient before execution; no fitting, search, CAL use, result-adaptive tuning, or rescue tuning.

proposed_primary_metrics.baseline_2: C1_ORACLE_minus_C1 from already-frozen oracle evidence; oracle is reference evidence only and need not be rerun
proposed_primary_metrics.proxy_recovery_fraction: Clamp to [0,1] the fraction of the already-observed C1-to-oracle log-loss improvement recovered by C1_PRE_LINE_MEAN_PROXY relative to frozen C1; report without using it for tuning.

proposed_interpretation_without_model_wi.proxy_beats_or_ties_N1: A simple PRE aggregate is sufficient to recover at least the fixed N1 W1 advantage on these Synthetic fixtures; prioritize parsimonious PRE-level shared-state representation over architectural winner claims.
proposed_interpretation_without_model_wi.proxy_improves_C1_but_N1_remains_better: Observable line aggregation recovers part of the hidden-state value but does not fully explain N1's conditional advantage; treat as mixed representation/architecture mechanism.
proposed_interpretation_without_model_wi.proxy_changes_little_or_worsens_C1: The oracle mechanism exists in the simulator, but this simple PRE line-mean estimator is insufficient; do not tune the coefficient after seeing the result. A different proxy would be a new Research/Candidate question.
proposed_interpretation_without_model_wi.any_direction: Scientific success is valid falsification/diagnosis, not making N1 or the proxy win.

required_future_execution_guards_if_sepa: Fresh Read canonical main, VNEXT state, CURRENT_STATE_KEIRIN, limited-synthetic receipt, this design, mechanism synthesis, oracle evidence and fixed source blobs immediately before execution.
Keep latent_skill absent from PRE and prohibit any direct latent/truth access in C1_PRE_LINE_MEAN_PROXY.
Require C1 and N1 predictions to reproduce existing non-oracle paths exactly.
No coefficient fitting, coefficient sweep, seed addition, result-aware subgroup selection, retuning, rescue, promotion, economics or real-data access.
Record any outcome and do not automatically create a second proxy after the result.

execution_boundary.required_action_before_execution: Fresh scope classification. If the new diagnostic control is outside current C0/C1/N1 authority, obtain a separate governed Owner gate before execution.
